title: Downtown Lafayette
tagline: Connect visitors to the businesses, culture, and stories of Lafayette's urban core through one spatial destination experience.
overview: Commissioned by the Lafayette Convention and Visitors Commission, Downtown Lafayette is a living destination experience that brings local places, businesses, culture, and stories into a connected interactive tour. The same experience can be opened on phone or desktop and has been demonstrated on Meta Quest Pro and Apple Vision Pro.

project.name: Lafayette Convention and Visitors Commission (LCVC)
project.blurb: Downtown Lafayette extends destination storytelling beyond a static page by making individual places part of a connected spatial experience. Visitors can explore captured venue interiors and move through the broader downtown context while encountering the businesses, culture, and stories that define Lafayette's urban core. The experience is designed around one build that works across phone and desktop and has also been demonstrated on Meta Quest Pro and Apple Vision Pro, giving the destination a reusable experience across devices.
